description: This file defines an abstract base class interface for storage backend implementations in a file storage system, including method signatures for uploading, downloading, and optionally deleting files.

classes.name: BaseFileStorageBackend
classes.description: Abstract base class for file storage backends that enforces implementation of upload and download methods, with an optional delete method.

methods.name: str upload_file( self, file_content: bytes, filename: str, content_type: str, path_prefix: Optional[str] = None, file_naming_strategy: str = "uuid", )
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a file to the storage backend and returns the access URL.

methods.name: bytes download_file(self, storage_url: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a file from the storage backend given its URL.

methods.name: None delete_file(self, storage_url: str)
methods.description: Optionally deletes a file from the storage backend; default implementation does nothing.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_file(self, storage_url: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: download_file
ctags.pattern: /^    async def download_file(self, storage_url: str) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.signature: ( self, file_content: bytes, filename: str, content_type: str, path_prefix: Optional[str] = None, file_naming_strategy: str = "uuid", )
